figures.target_detail: 质控清单·粒径与浓度（NTA）；亦可放方法卡横向对比
figures.title_zh: 同一批样本、四种方法：NTA 粒径分布长什么样
figures.caption_zh: 这张图把细胞培养上清、尿液、血浆三类样本分别用超速离心（UC）、沉淀、Exodisc、SEC+超滤（SEC+UF）分离后，用 NTA 测得的粒径分布并排放在一起（每列一种样本，每行一种方法）。怎么读：横轴是颗粒直径（nm），纵轴是颗粒浓度；作者把每张图的峰高都调到量程的 95%，所以只能比较“形状”（峰位置、峰宽、拖尾），不能直接比较高低。一般认为小 EV 制备的主峰落在约 100–150 nm 附近且拖尾有限；尿液列可见部分方法出现更宽的肩峰和拖尾。注意：NTA 只数“颗粒”，蛋白聚集体、脂蛋白同样会被计入，单看粒径分布不能证明纯度，需与蛋白定量、Western blot 合看。
figures.original_shows_en: NTA particle size distributions of EV preparations from cell culture medium, urine and plasma, each separated by UC, precipitation, Exodisc and SEC+UF; y-axes scaled so the modal peak is 95% of full scale in each panel.
figures.original_legend_quote: Particle size distributions of EV preparations separated by different methods from CCM, urine and plasma, measured by NTA. The concentration of particles in each bin of size was recorded. The bin width was 1.0 nm. In order to make the size distribution histogram visually comparable, the Y axis was adjusted to make the concentration of particles with modal size (the peak of the curve) as 95% of maximum scale in each figure. (a) Particle size distributions of CCM EV preparations; (b) Particle size distributions of urine EV preparations; (c) Particle size distributions of plasma EV preparations
figures.sample_type: 细胞培养上清（CCM）、人尿液、人血浆
figures.instrument_method: NTA（粒径分布）；比较 UC、沉淀、Exodisc、SEC+UF 四种分离方法
figures.citation: Dong L, Zieren RC, Horie K, Kim CJ, Mallick E, Jing Y, et al.. Comprehensive evaluation of methods for small extracellular vesicles separation from human plasma, urine and cell culture medium. J Extracell Vesicles. 2020;10(2):e12044. doi:10.1002/jev2.12044

figures.title_zh: 负染 TEM：三类样本、四种方法下的 EV 形貌
figures.caption_zh: 每类样本左侧为低倍（标尺 500 nm）、右侧为高倍（标尺 100 nm）负染 TEM 图，黑色箭头标出作者认为符合 EV 形态标准的颗粒。怎么读：负染 TEM 下 EV 常呈“杯状”（这是干燥制样造成的伪影，不是天然形态）；低倍图用来判断背景是否“干净”——背景中大量无膜的电子致密小点或成团物质，提示蛋白/脂蛋白等非 EV 成分。TEM 只能证明“有囊泡”，不能定量纯度，且操作者挑选的视野往往好于随机视野，建议同时报告低倍全景图。
figures.original_shows_en: Representative negative-stain TEM of CCM, urine and plasma EV preparations separated by different methods; low (500 nm scale) and high (100 nm scale) magnifications; black arrows mark particles meeting EV morphology criteria.
figures.original_legend_quote: TEM images confirmed presence of negative‐stained EVs, seen as cup‐shaped vesicles. Representative image of (a) CCM EV preparations, (b) urine EV preparations, (c) plasma EV preparations separated by different methods. Scale bar represented 500 nm in figures with low magnifications on the left side and 100 nm in figures with high magnifications on the right side in each sample. Black arrows pointed out particles with a morphology that meets the criteria of EV
figures.sample_type: 细胞培养上清、人尿液、人血浆
figures.instrument_method: 负染透射电镜（TEM）；UC / 沉淀 / Exodisc / SEC+UF

figures.target_detail: 质控清单·阳性/阴性标志物与纯度；分样本（尿液 THP、血浆 APOA1）可交叉引用
figures.title_zh: 纯度怎么看：颗粒/蛋白比 + 阳性与阴性标志物 Western blot
figures.caption_zh: 上排（a–c）为各方法所得制备物的蛋白量，中排（d–f）为颗粒/蛋白比，下排（g–i）为 Western blot：EV 阳性标志物 flotillin-1、CD63、CD81；细胞内阴性对照 calnexin；尿液中另检测 Tamm-Horsfall 蛋白（THP，尿调素），血浆中另检测载脂蛋白 APOA1（HDL 标志）。怎么读：“好”的结果是 EV 标志物条带清楚、calnexin 在 EV 泳道缺失（只在细胞膜组分对照 HI 中出现）、样本特异性污染物（THP、APOA1）弱或缺失，同时颗粒/蛋白比较高；沉淀类方法蛋白量高、颗粒/蛋白比低，是蛋白共沉淀的典型表现。图中可见尿液 THP 条带主要出现在 UC 泳道，血浆 APOA1 在多种方法泳道中均可见（请以原文统计为准）。
figures.original_shows_en: (a–c) protein concentrations and (d–f) particle/protein ratios (nFCM) of EV preparations from CCM, urine and plasma by different methods; (g–i) Western blots of flotillin-1, CD63, CD81, calnexin, plus THP for urine and APOA1 for plasma, with MCF7 membrane/cytosolic fractions, whole urine and recombinant APOA1 as controls.
figures.original_legend_quote: Purity of EV samples assessed by particle/protein ratio and Western blotting. (a)‐(c) The protein concentrations of EV preparations separated by different methods from CCM, urine and plasma. The protein concentrations have been corrected for initial sample input volume. (d)‐(f) The particle/protein ratios of EV preparations separated by different methods from CCM, urine and plasma. The particle numbers were measured by nFCM. The error bars represented the standard deviation of three repetitive experiments. *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, one‐way ANOVA analysis with Tukey multiple comparison test as well as a variance‐covariance model. (g) Western blots of flotillin‐1, CD63, CD81, and calnexin for EV preparations separated from CCM by different methods. 9 μg of protein from each EV preparation was loaded. (h) Western blots of flotillin‐1, CD63, CD81, THP and calnexin for EV preparations separated from urine by different methods. 3.3 μg of protein from each EV preparation was loaded. (i) Western blots of flotillin‐1, CD81, APOA1 and calnexin for EV preparations separated from plasma by different methods. 25 μg of protein from each EV preparation was loaded. MCF7 membrane and cytosolic protein fractions served as positive and negative controls for flotillin‐1, CD63, CD81 and calnexin. Whole urine sample was used as positive control and MCF7 cellular fractions as negative control for THP. Recombinant human Apolipoprotein A1 served as positive control for APOA1.GAPDH staining was to show proper loading and running of the cytosolic MCF7 fraction
figures.sample_type: 细胞培养上清、人尿液、人血浆
figures.instrument_method: BCA 蛋白定量 + nFCM 颗粒计数（颗粒/蛋白比）+ Western blot（flotillin-1、CD63、CD81、calnexin、THP、APOA1）

figures.target_detail: 方法卡·2 密度梯度离心（DGUC）
figures.title_zh: 密度梯度分级：EV 在哪一层，脂蛋白和蛋白聚集体在哪一层
figures.caption_zh: （a）血浆经 UC 后再做密度梯度离心，8 个组分（顶部标注密度 1.076–1.313 g/mL）等体积上样，检测 flotillin-1 和 CD81；（b）作者把组分分成低（<1.10）、中（1.10–1.15）、高（>1.15）三组并配 TEM：低密度组见脂质/脂蛋白等非 EV 颗粒，中密度组见杯状 EV，高密度组见蛋白聚集体等；（c–h）各方法制备物在三组中的颗粒比例与浓度。怎么读：EV 标志物应集中在约 1.10–1.15 g/mL 的中间组分；若大量颗粒落在低密度组（血浆中提示脂蛋白）或高密度组（蛋白聚集体），说明前一步分离的特异性不足。
figures.original_shows_en: (a) WB of flotillin-1 and CD81 across 8 DGUC fractions from 8 mL plasma (UC then DGUC; equal volume loaded); (b) design schematic and TEM of low/middle/high density groups — non-EV particles (lipids, lipoproteins) in low-density, cup-shaped EVs in middle, protein aggregates in high-density fractions; (c–h) proportions and particle concentrations of density groups for each method and sample.
figures.original_legend_quote: Composition analysis of EV preparations DGUC. (a) Western blots of flotillin‐1 and CD81 for different fractions (n = 8) separated from 8 ml of plasma by UC, followed by DGUC fractionation. The same volume of each fraction was loaded regardless of their protein amount. (b) Schematic diagram of the study design and representative TEM images of each density fraction group. Non‐EV particles, like lipids and lipoproteins, were found in low‐density fractions, cup‐shaped EVs were seen in the middle fraction and protein aggregates and other particles were observed in high‐density fractions. Scale bar represented 100 nm. (c)‐(e) Proportions of fraction groups with different densities in EV preparations from CCM, urine and plasma separated by different methods. (f)‐(h) The particle concentration of each fraction group in EV preparations from CCM, urine and plasma separated by different methods. The particle numbers were measured by nFCM. The particle concentrations have been corrected for sample input volumes. The error bars represented the standard deviation of three repetitive experiments
figures.sample_type: 人血浆（a，8 mL）；CCM/尿液/血浆制备物的密度分组（c–h）
figures.instrument_method: UC 后密度梯度超速离心（DGUC）分级 + Western blot + TEM + nFCM
figures.citation: Dong L, Zieren RC, Horie K, Kim CJ, Mallick E, Jing Y, et al.. Comprehensive evaluation of methods for small extracellular vesicles separation from human plasma, urine and cell culture medium. J Extracell Vesicles. 2020;10(2):e12044. doi:10.1002/jev2.12044

figures.target_detail: 方法卡·3 尺寸排阻色谱（SEC）；分样本·血浆可交叉引用
figures.title_zh: SEC 洗脱曲线：颗粒峰先出、蛋白峰后出——但 HDL 会跟着 EV 一起出来
figures.caption_zh: （a）血浆/血清上 SEC 柱后，各组分颗粒（蓝，NTA）与蛋白（绿，BCA）占比：颗粒峰出现在较早的组分，大量可溶蛋白在后段组分洗脱，两峰分开正是 SEC 的价值；（b）四跨膜蛋白 CD9/CD63/CD81 的 ELISA 分布与颗粒峰大体重合；（c）Western blot 显示 EV 标志 flotillin-1 与 HDL 标志 Apo-A1 在组分 7–12 中都能检出；（d、e）负染 TEM 中黑箭头为杯状 EV 样结构，白箭头为脂蛋白样颗粒。怎么读：好的 SEC 结果是“颗粒峰与蛋白峰分离、EV 标志物集中在颗粒峰”；但本图同时提示，血浆中 HDL 与 EV 尺寸重叠，单用 SEC 无法去除，需要加做密度步骤或检测 ApoA1/ApoB。
figures.original_shows_en: SEC (Sepharose CL-2B) of 1 mL plasma/serum: (a) particle (NTA) vs protein (BCA) distribution across fractions 5–16; (b) CD9/CD63/CD81 ELISA; (c) WB of flotillin-1 and HDL marker Apo-A1 in fractions 7–12; (d,e) negative-stain EM with EV-like (black arrows) and lipoprotein-like (white arrows) structures.
figures.original_legend_quote: Evaluation of EVs isolated with size-exclusion chromatography (SEC). One millilitre of plasma or serum was loaded onto 10 mL Sepharose CL-2B columns, and up to 30 fractions of 500 µL were collected from each column. a Concentrations of particles and proteins in the SEC fractions were determined with nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA; ZetaView®, blue) and BCA (green), respectively. Data are presented as the percentage of the total amount of particles or proteins in fractions 5–16. N = 4–6, and the results are presented as the average ± SEM. b ELISA was used to determine the expression of CD9, CD63, and CD81 on the vesicles in the SEC fractions. Data are presented as the percentage of the total expression for each protein in fractions 5–16. N = 3–5, and the results are presented as the average ± SEM. c Presence of the vesicle marker flotillin-1 and the HDL marker Apo-A1 was determined in fractions 7–12 (40 µL/fraction) with Western blot. d, e Fifteen microliters (1–20 µg protein) from fractions 8–11 were loaded onto grids, negative stained, and evaluated with electron microscopy. Examples of EV-like structures (cup-shaped) are indicated by black arrows, and examples of lipoprotein particle-like structures (white structures) are indicated by white arrows. e Enlargements from fraction 8–10 from the plasma sample showed in d. Scale bars are 200 nm in d and 100 nm in e
figures.instrument_method: Sepharose CL-2B SEC（10 mL 柱，0.5 mL/组分）；NTA（ZetaView）+ BCA；ELISA（CD9/CD63/CD81）；WB（flotillin-1、Apo-A1）；负染 TEM
figures.citation: Karimi N, Cvjetkovic A, Jang SC, Crescitelli R, Hosseinpour Feizi MA, Nieuwland R, et al.. Detailed analysis of the plasma extracellular vesicle proteome after separation from lipoproteins. Cell Mol Life Sci. 2018;75(15):2873-2886. doi:10.1007/s00018-018-2773-4

figures.target_detail: 分样本·血浆（脂蛋白去除的组合策略）；亦可放“推荐的组合思路”
figures.title_zh: 血浆“两步法”：密度垫 + SEC 把 EV 与脂蛋白分开
figures.caption_zh: （a）血浆加在碘克沙醇密度垫上超速离心后出现两条带：低密度带（<1.025 g/cm³）与高密度带（约 1.06–1.16 g/cm³）；（b）两条带分别再过 SEC，测各组分颗粒与蛋白；（c）低密度带与高密度带的颗粒数倍数比较；（d）Western blot：EV 标志 flotillin-1、TSG-101 与 HDL 标志 Apo-A1 在两条带各组分中的分布；（e）负染 TEM。怎么读：原文用这一组合来把 EV 从脂蛋白和血浆蛋白中分出来；判读时看高密度带的 SEC 组分中 TSG-101 等 EV 标志物是否保留、Apo-A1 等脂蛋白信号是否相对减少——这比单用一种方法更接近“干净”的血浆 EV。具体结论请以原文结果部分为准。
figures.original_shows_en: IDC+SEC: (a) low-density (<1.025 g/cm3) and high-density (~1.06–1.16 g/cm3) bands after cushion UC of 6 mL plasma; (b) particle/protein distributions in SEC fractions of each band; (c) LD vs HD particle fold change; (d) WB of flotillin-1, TSG-101 and Apo-A1 in fractions 7–14 of each band; (e) negative-stain EM.
figures.original_legend_quote: Evaluation of EVs isolated with the combination of density cushion and size-exclusion chromatography (IDC + SEC). Six millilitres of plasma were loaded on top of a density cushion (50%/30%/10% iodixanol), and visible bands after ultracentrifugation were further loaded onto 10 mL Sepharose CL-2B columns, and up to 30 fractions of 500 µL each were collected. a After centrifuging of the plasma sample on top of the cushion, two bands were visible. One band contained material floating above 1.025 g/cm3 (low-density band), and the second band contained material floating at approximately 1.06–1.16 g/cm3 (high-density band). b Low-density and high-density bands were loaded onto individual SEC columns, and fractions were collected. The concentrations of particles and proteins in the SEC fractions were determined by nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA; ZetaView®, blue) and BCA (green), respectively. Data are presented as the percentage of the total amount of particles or proteins in fractions 5–16. N = 3, and the results are presented as the average ± SEM. c Total number of particles was determined by ZetaView® in fractions 5–16 from the high-density and low-density bands isolated from the same plasma samples, and the fold change was calculated. N = 3, and the results are presented as the average ± SEM. LD low-density, HD high-density. d Presence of the vesicle markers flotillin-1 and TSG-101 as well as the HDL marker Apo-A1 was determined by Western blot of fractions 7–14 (40 µL/fraction) isolated from both the high-density and low-density band. e Fifteen microliters (1–6 µg protein) from fractions 8–10 from the high-density and low-density bands were loaded onto grids, negative stained, and evaluated with electron microscopy. Scale bars are 200 nm
figures.instrument_method: 碘克沙醇密度垫（50%/30%/10%）超速离心 + SEC；NTA + BCA；WB（flotillin-1、TSG-101、Apo-A1）；负染 TEM

figures.target_detail: 方法卡·5 聚合物沉淀（PEG 等）——“污染长什么样”的反例
figures.title_zh: 冷冻电镜对比：SEC 见到单个囊泡，PEG 沉淀只见到一片致密杂质
figures.caption_zh: （A）SEC 合并组分中可见直径约 80–200 nm 的单个囊泡，膜结构清楚；（B）PEG 沉淀样品中找不到囊泡，整张载网被电子致密颗粒覆盖，原文解读为污染物共沉淀；（C）PROSPR 方法得到的是多层同心囊泡，多数 300–500 nm。怎么读：冷冻电镜在水合状态下成像，EV 呈圆形双层膜（不出现杯状伪影）；“好”的制备物背景干净、能看到清晰的膜；如果整片是无结构的致密物，即使 NTA 颗粒数很高，也说明大部分“颗粒”不是 EV。
figures.original_shows_en: Cryo-EM: (A) pooled SEC fractions show single vesicles 80–200 nm; (B) no vesicles in PEG-precipitated samples, electron-dense particles covering the grid indicating co-precipitated contaminants; (C) PROSPR vesicles appear as concentric multilayered vesicles, mostly 300–500 nm.
figures.original_legend_quote: Cryo-EM images. (A) Pooled SEC fractions showed single vesicles of size between 80–200 nm. (B) No vesicles were found in Cryo-EM images from PEG precipitated samples. Electron dense particles covered the whole grid indicating co-precipitation of contaminants. (C) PROSPR isolated vesicles were visualized as concentric multi-layered vesicles, mostly measuring from 300 to 500 nm. Scale bars are shown for each image.
figures.sample_type: 人血浆来源 EV（原文：每种方法 n = 1 份制备物用于冷冻电镜）
figures.instrument_method: 冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）；SEC vs PEG 沉淀 vs PROSPR
figures.citation: Gámez-Valero A, Monguió-Tortajada M, Carreras-Planella L, Franquesa Ml, Beyer K, Borràs FE. Size-Exclusion Chromatography-based isolation minimally alters Extracellular Vesicles' characteristics compared to precipitating agents. Sci Rep. 2016;6(1):33641. doi:10.1038/srep33641

figures.title_zh: 血清 EV 的“双面板”：EV 标志物与脂蛋白标志物同时检测
figures.caption_zh: 每种方法取 4 µg 蛋白上样，同时检测 EV 标志物 CD63、TSG101 与脂蛋白标志物 APOB（LDL/VLDL）、APOE；（B）为三次分离的条带定量。怎么读：血浆/血清 EV 报告不能只放 CD63/TSG101，“好”的结果应是 EV 标志物明显、而 APOB/APOE 尽量弱；图中可见沉淀法与单独 SEC 泳道的 APOB/APOE 信号较明显，而含密度梯度（DG-UC）的组合方案 EV 标志物更突出（定量与统计以原文为准）。这说明 SEC 与沉淀都会带入脂蛋白，密度步骤是去除脂蛋白的关键。
figures.original_shows_en: (A) WB of 4 µg vesicular protein from 200 µL serum by each method or combination, probed for CD63 (H-193, H5C6), TSG101, APOE and APOB; (B) densitometric quantitation (N = 3 isolations).
figures.original_legend_quote: Western blot analysis of EV markers, CD63 and TSG101, and lipoprotein markers, APOB, and APOE. (A) 4 µg of vesicular protein isolated from 200 µl human serum using each method alone or in combination were separated by SDS–PAGE and immunoblotted with anti-human CD63 (H-193 and H5C6), TSG101, APOE and APOB antibodies. Representative images are shown. (B) Graph: Densitometric quantitation of the distribution of CD63, TSG101, APOE and APOB protein expression in each method. Black lines represent medians. N = 3 isolations. Arbitrary Units (AU) = (signal intensity method)/Sum (signal intensity method1–8).
figures.instrument_method: Western blot：CD63（两种克隆）、TSG101、APOB、APOE；ExoQuick Plus、qEV1/qEV2（SEC）、UC、DG-UC 及其组合共 8 种方案

figures.title_zh: TFF 与超速离心正面对比：产量、粒径、形貌、标志物和白蛋白残留
figures.caption_zh: （a）死端过滤与切向流过滤的原理示意：TFF 液流平行于膜面，减少滤膜堵塞；（b）EV 产量（TFF 显著高于 UC）；（c）三次重复的粒径分布（虚线 UC，实线 TFF）；（d、e）UC 与 TFF 所得 EV 的 TEM；（f）TFF 样品 Western blot：EV 中检出 CD63、CD81，不含细胞内标志 calnexin（H 为细胞匀浆对照）；（g）每 10⁶ 个 EV 的白蛋白残留，TFF 低于 UC。怎么读：一张合格的方法比较图应同时给出产量、粒径、形貌、阳性/阴性标志物和一个“污染物”指标（这里是白蛋白），而不是只比颗粒数。
figures.original_shows_en: EVs from MDA-MB-231 culture media by UC vs TFF: (a) dead-end vs TFF schematic; (b) EV yield; (c) size distributions; (d,e) TEM; (f) WB of calnexin, CD63, CD81 in TFF samples with cellular homogenate control; (g) albumin contaminant levels (mean ± s.d.; ** p < 0.01).
figures.original_legend_quote: Biophysical and biochemical characterization of extracellular vesicles (EVs) isolated from MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cell culture media using ultracentrifugation (UC) or tangential flow filtration (TFF). (a) Schematic illustrating the difference between dead-end filtration and TFF; (b) EV yield; (c) Size distribution (0–650 nm) of EVs isolated with UC (dashed lines) and TFF (continuous lines); (d,e) Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) of EVs obtained with UC (d) or TFF (e); (f) Western blot of characteristic intracellular (calnexin) and EV (CD63, CD81) markers in samples isolated by TFF; (g) Levels of albumin contaminants in EV samples. Cellular homogenate (H) was used as a control. Data are presented as mean ± s.d. of three biological replicates (b,c) or experimental replicates (g). Statistical significance was evaluated by Student’s t-test. ** p < 0.01.

figures.target_detail: 七种主流方法详解·开头总览 / 横向对比速查
figures.title_zh: MISEV2023：各分离方法在“回收率 vs 特异性”坐标上的位置
figures.caption_zh: 左侧为七类方法的原理小图（沉淀 P、差速超速离心 dUC、过滤浓缩 FC、密度梯度 DG、SEC、免疫/亲和沉淀 IP/AP、非对称流场流分离 AF4），右上为“回收率–特异性”坐标，蓝色虚线箭头表示方法组合后特异性提高。怎么读：越靠左上回收率高但特异性低（如沉淀），越靠右下特异性高但回收率低（如 IP、AF4）；原文特别指出很多“外泌体提取试剂盒”本质是沉淀，得到的是各种细胞外颗粒的混合物，而不是纯外泌体。这是示意图，不是测量数据。
figures.original_shows_en: Position of EV separation/concentration methods on a recovery versus specificity grid; dashed arrows indicate method combinations increasing specificity; notes that many exosome kits use precipitation and isolate mixtures of EPs.
figures.original_legend_quote: Position of some EV separation and concentration methods on a recovery (yield) versus specificity grid. Dashed blue arrows indicate combinations of methods resulting in increased specificity. Specificity can be of different types: Size exclusion chromatography (SEC) separates EVs by size from many (but not all) NVEPs, but all EV types are recovered together, while differential ultracentrifugation (dUC) separates EV subtypes based on their size/weight, but also co‐isolates NVEPs at high speeds. Note that many ‘exosome purification’ kits use precipitation (P), thus do not isolate pure exosomes or even EVs but a mixture of EPs, while some use affinity precipitation (AP), which may be more specific to EVs but not exosomes. Those who develop new methods should consider positioning their EV outcomes on such a graph.
figures.instrument_method: 沉淀、dUC、过滤浓缩、密度梯度、SEC、免疫/亲和沉淀、AF4 的原理示意与“回收率–特异性”定位
figures.citation: Welsh JA, Goberdhan DCI, O'Driscoll L, Buzas EI, Blenkiron C, Bussolati B, et al.. Minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles (MISEV2023): From basic to advanced approaches. J Extracell Vesicles. 2024;13(2):e12404. doi:10.1002/jev2.12404

figures.title_zh: AF4 流场分离图（fractogram）：按洗脱时间读出颗粒大小
figures.caption_zh: （A）同一受试者血浆经蔗糖垫超速离心（sUC，红）或 SEC（绿）富集后的 AF4 流场分离图：实线为多角度光散射（LS）信号，虚线为紫外（UV）信号；（B）LS 信号放大，插图为由 MALS 计算的洗脱颗粒几何直径（2×Rgeom），随洗脱时间增大；（C）sUC 样品的颗粒浓度与粒径（N = 8）。怎么读：AF4 中小颗粒先洗脱、大颗粒后洗脱，可以在一次运行中把不同大小的颗粒分开并测粒径；UV 信号高而 LS 信号弱的早期峰通常对应蛋白等小分子量成分。注意：本图是血浆 EV 的 AF4 测量，不是 exomere/supermere 的分离图（见“缺口”说明）。
figures.original_shows_en: AF4-UV-MALS of plasma nanoparticles enriched by sUC or SEC: (A) representative fractogram with MALS (solid) and UV (dotted) signals vs elution time; (B) magnified MALS signal with inset of calculated size (2*Rgeom); (C) particle size and concentration after sUC (N = 8).
figures.original_legend_quote: Quantification of enriched nanoparticles from human blood plasma by AF4-UV-MALS. (A) Representative fractogram. Representation of MALS (LS) and UV signals in relation to elution time in sample from subject 9 (S9) after sUC or SEC. Dotted lines present UV signals, solid lines present MALS signals. (B) Representative fractogram. Magnification of the MALS(LS) signal. The inset represents calculated size of eluted particles, presented as 2*Rgeom. (C) Particle size and concentration in samples after sUC. Each circle or triangle presents one sample. N = 8. AF4-UV-MALS asymmetrical flow field-flow fractionation with ultraviolet and multi-angle light scattering detectors, sUC sucrose cushion ultracentrifugation, SEC size exclusion chromatography, Rgeom geometric radius.

figures.target_detail: 分样本·血浆（脂蛋白干扰）
figures.title_zh: LDL 会“伪装”并粘附在 EV 表面：电镜下的样子
figures.caption_zh: （A）商品化 LDL：高电子密度、圆形并聚集；（B）细胞系来源微囊泡（MV）呈囊泡形态；（C）LDL 与 MV 体外混合 1 小时后，电子致密的 LDL 大量结合并覆盖在 MV 表面，并形成与囊泡大小相当的聚集体；（D）细胞系来源外泌体；（E）外泌体与 LDL 混合后表面同样被 LDL 覆盖，图中与外泌体大小相当的电子致密颗粒为 LDL 聚集体。（所有标尺 500 nm）怎么读：血浆 EV 电镜图中若看到大量实心、深染、无膜的圆形颗粒或附着在囊泡表面的致密物，应考虑脂蛋白污染；这也是 NTA/流式会把脂蛋白误计为 EV 的原因。
figures.original_shows_en: TEM (osmification-on-grid): (A) commercial LDL, electron-dense and aggregating; (B) cell line-derived MVs; (C) LDL mixed with MVs for 1 h binds extensively onto MV surfaces and forms aggregates in vesicle size range; (D) cell line-derived EXOs; (E) EXOs mixed with LDL, surfaces covered with LDL. Scale bars 500 nm.
figures.original_legend_quote: LDL binds onto isolated MVs and EXOs in vitro. (A,B) TEM analysis of commercial LDL (A) and cell line-derived MVs (B) using the “osmification-on-grid” method. LDL particles appear as highly electron-dense, round structures and show aggregation (A) (scale bars: 500 nm). MVs isolated from the conditioned media of a cell line had vesicular morphology (B) (scale bars: 500 nm). (C) TEM images obtained after in vitro mixing of commercial LDL with cell-derived MVs for 1 h at room temperature (scale bar: 500 nm). Electron-dense LDL was observed to bind extensively onto MVs, to cover their surfaces, and to form aggregates in the size range of the vesicles. Note that almost all MVs were covered with LDL particles to various extents. (D) TEM picture of cell line-derived EXOs (scale bar: 500 nm). (E) Images of cell line-derived EXOs in vitro mixed with commercial LDL. Note that the surfaces of the EXOs are covered with LDL particles. The electron dense particles in the size range of EXOs represent LDL aggregates (scale bar: 500 nm).
figures.sample_type: 商品化人 LDL 与细胞系来源的 MV/外泌体（体外混合实验）

figures.target_detail: 分样本·尿液（THP 网罗与还原剂处理）
figures.title_zh: 尿液 EV 被 THP（尿调素）纤维“网住”：还原处理前后冷冻电镜对比
figures.caption_zh: （A–F）还原处理前的低速离心沉淀 P21：可见单层囊泡和内含小囊泡的多层结构，以及 Tamm-Horsfall 蛋白（THP）的长丝状聚合物（箭头），有的包裹囊泡（*），有的吸附囊泡（#）；（G1–G6）经还原剂 TCEP 处理后，看不到 THP 纤维。怎么读：尿液中 THP 聚合物会把 EV 拖进低速沉淀里、或混入超速离心沉淀，导致丢失或污染；用还原剂打散 THP 网络后，EV 视野更“干净”。注意：本图使用的还原剂是 TCEP，不是 DTT；DTT 处理的经典做法见尿液 EV 立场文件与文献 [38]，但本次未找到 CC BY 授权的 DTT 前后对比图。
figures.original_shows_en: Cryo-TEM gallery of urinary EVs in low-speed pellet P21 before (A–F) and after TCEP reduction (G1–G6); THP long polymeric filaments (arrows) engulfing (*) or adsorbing (#) vesicles visible before reduction; no THP filaments visible after TCEP reduction.
figures.original_legend_quote: Gallery of Cryo-TEM images of urinary EVs recovered in the relative low centrifugation pellet P21 before and after TCEP reduction (P21TCEP). A heterogeneous population of uEVs was observed including single layered vesicles and multiyered structure with two or more inner small vesicles encapsulated inside bigger vesicles before (A–F) and after TCEP treatment (G1–G6). Tamm-Horsfall protein (THP) long polymeric filaments (indicated by arrows) (A) either engulfing (*) (C) or adsorbing (#) vesicles (B and b1) were also visible. No filaments of THP were visible (G1–G6) after TCEP reduction.
figures.sample_type: 健康人尿液，约 2 万 g 低速离心沉淀（P21）
figures.instrument_method: 冷冻透射电镜（cryo-TEM）；TCEP 还原处理前后对比

figures.target_detail: 分样本·尿液（ISEV 尿液工作组立场文件）
figures.title_zh: 同一类尿液 EV，三种成像方式：冷冻电镜、负染 TEM、超分辨
figures.caption_zh: （a）2 万 g 离心沉淀的尿液 EV 冷冻电镜：大小、密度、形态差异很大，箭头所示为尿调素（uromodulin，即 THP）聚合物，似乎将 EV 网罗其中；右图高倍可见膜外刺状结构（可能为糖萼）；（b）10 万 g 超速离心沉淀的负染 TEM：大量形态各异的 EV，杯状形态来自 TEM 制样；（c）超分辨显微下单个 EV 上 CD81（青）与 Klotho（品红）的纳米级分布。怎么读：同一份样本在冷冻电镜下是圆形、在负染下是杯状，这是制样方式差异，不代表质量好坏；尿液样本要特别留意尿调素纤维。
figures.original_shows_en: uEV microscopy: (a) cryo-EM of 20,000 × g pellet — heterogeneous EVs and uromodulin polymers that seem to entrap uEVs (arrows); (b) negative-stain TEM of 100,000 × g pellet with cup-shaped morphology due to processing; (c) dSTORM super-resolution images of CD81 and Klotho on uEVs.
figures.original_legend_quote: uEV microscopy. (a) Urinary EVs (uEVs) were isolated by centrifugation (20,000 × g pellet) and processed for cryoelectron microscopy (as described in (Musante et al., 2020)). The left image shows a wide variety of EVs in size, density and shape. In addition, polymers of uromodulin are shown which seem to entrap uEVs (see arrows). The right image shows a higher magnification of uEVs demonstrating spike like structures emerging from the phospholipid bilayer which likely represents the glycocalyx of some uEVs. (b) uEVs were isolated with ultracentrifugation (100,000 × g pellet) and processed for transmission electron microscopy (TEM) using a negative staining protocol (as described in (Puhka et al., 2017)). To the left there is a lower magnification image displaying a large number and variety of uEVs in size, shape and density. The right image shows a higher magnification demonstrating the uEV heterogeneity with differential staining densities and some spike like surface features that can be visualized despite the cup shape morphology which is due to the processing of TEM. (c) Super‐resolution images were obtained using a Nanoimager S Mark II microscope from ONI (Oxford Nanoimaging) equipped with 405 nm/150 mW, 473 nm/1 W, 560 nm/1 W, 640 nm/1 W lasers and dual emission channels split at 640 nm. The figure shows uEVs stained for CD81 (cyan) and Klotho (magenta) using primary antibodies conjugated with Alexa Fluor 555 and 647 respectively. Representative images with zoomed in insets show the expression and nanoscale distribution of the peptide and tetraspanin on the surface of two representative EVs bound to the coverslip surface. Two‐channel dSTORM data was acquired sequentially at 30 Hz in total internal reflection fluorescence (TIRF) mode. Single molecule data was filtered using NimOS (Version 1.7.1.10213, ONI) based on point spread function shape, photon count and localization precision to minimize background noise and remove low precision localizations
figures.sample_type: 人尿液（a：2 万 g 沉淀；b：10 万 g 沉淀）
figures.instrument_method: 冷冻电镜、负染 TEM、超分辨显微（dSTORM，CD81/Klotho）

figures.target_detail: 标准工作流程（细胞培养上清）·“换无 EV 血清”一步；分样本·细胞培养上清
figures.title_zh: “去 EV 血清”并不等于“无 EV”：三种培养基的颗粒背景
figures.caption_zh: （A）三种完全培养基叠加对比（已按稀释倍数校正）：红线为未处理 FBS，蓝线为 18 小时超速离心去 EV 的 FBS，绿线为商品化 Exo-FBS；（B–D）分别为三种培养基的单独测量（稀释 1:1000、1:250、1:333）；虚线框为作者定义的 75–165 nm EV 区间。怎么读：两种“去 EV”血清的颗粒浓度都低于未处理 FBS，但仍能测到明显的颗粒峰——也就是牛源 EV 仍然存在。实操上，应把“只含培养基、不接细胞”的空白培养基按同样流程提取，作为本底对照，从结果中扣除。
figures.original_shows_en: NTA (ZetaView) concentration and size distributions of complete culture media with untreated FBS, 18-h UC EV-depleted FBS, and commercial Exo-FBS; (A) superposition with dilution-adjusted relative concentrations; (B–D) individual conditions; dashed threshold for 75–165 nm EVs.
figures.original_legend_quote: Concentrations and Size Distributions of the Complete Culture Media (CM) Conditions. Untreated fetal bovine serum (FBS)-supplemented complete CM and extracellular vesicles (EV)-depleted FBS-supplemented complete CM (ultracentrifugation (UC) and commercial) were prepared for EV particle analysis using the ZetaVIEW® PMX 110 instrument. Each sample replicate was an independent measure acquired on the instrument (total sample volume of 1 mL) and then grand averaged. Size distribution data was then analyzed and plotted by BPM ExoPlot, with filter and smoothing functions, as depicted in the Methods. For all complete CM conditions, graphical representation was set with a “sgolay smooth” smoothing function; this is an algorithm that is a built-in function to MATLAB® signal processing toolbox. Dashed threshold line was defined for EVs with diameters ranging from 75–165 nm. (A), Superposition of all three complete CM conditions on the same scaled axes with appropriately adjusted dilution factors to show relative concentration values across each complete CM condition. Individual graphs with detailed measurement parameters are presented for: (B), Untreated FBS-supplemented complete CM (n = 3 replicates, dilution factor = 1:1000), (C), 18-h UC-FBS-supplemented complete CM (n = 3 replicates, dilution factor = 1:250), and (D), Exo-FBS™-supplemented complete CM (n = 3 replicates, dilution factor = 1:333.33).
figures.sample_type: 含 FBS 的完全培养基：未处理 FBS、18 h 超速离心去 EV 的 FBS、商品化 Exo-FBS
figures.citation: Lehrich BM, Liang Y, Khosravi P, Federoff HJ, Fiandaca MS. Fetal Bovine Serum-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Persist within Vesicle-Depleted Culture Media. Int J Mol Sci. 2018;19(11):3538. doi:10.3390/ijms19113538

figures.target_detail: 分样本·其他体液（脑脊液）
figures.title_zh: 脑脊液 EV 的冷冻电镜：形态远不止“一个圆”
figures.caption_zh: （A）单个囊泡；（B、K）双囊泡；（C、L）双层膜囊泡；（C–F、L）多层囊泡；（G–J、L）腔内含电子致密内容物的囊泡；（K、M）膜破损的囊泡；黑箭头指双层膜囊泡，白箭头指“保龄球瓶”形囊泡。标尺 50 nm。怎么读：冷冻电镜下 EV 呈完整的圆形脂双层膜，能分辨多种亚型；脑脊液样本量少、EV 含量低，冷冻电镜可以直接确认“提到的是膜性囊泡”。原文同时给出对照组的图（Fig 4），本图只展示 PD 患者样本。
figures.original_shows_en: Cryo-EM of EVs from pooled CSF of PD patients: single, double, double-membrane, multilayer vesicles, vesicles with electron-dense cargo, and vesicles with broken membranes; arrows mark double-membrane (black) and "bowling pin" (white) vesicles. Scale bars 50 nm.
figures.original_legend_quote: Cryo-EM images of EVs isolated from pooled CSF of Parkinson's disease patients. (A) Single vesicles; (B, K) double vesicles; (C, L) double-membrane vesicles; (C-F, L) multilayer vesicles; (G-J, L) vesicles with electron dense cargo in lumen; (K, M) vesicles with broken membrane. The arrows point to vesicle with double membrane (black arrow) and “bowling pin” vesicle (white arrow). Scale bars are 50 nm.
figures.sample_type: 帕金森病患者混合脑脊液来源 EV

figures.title_zh: 唾液外泌体的经典表征组合：电镜 + 免疫金 + 流式 + WB
figures.caption_zh: （A）唾液 12 万 g 沉淀的负染电镜，可见约 60 nm 的小囊泡；（B）抗 CD63 免疫金标记，金颗粒位于单个囊泡表面；（C）乳胶珠结合后流式检测 CD63（实心峰为染色样本，空心峰为对照）；（D）Western blot：泳道 1 为唾液总蛋白，泳道 2 为外泌体沉淀，检测 CD63 与 Alix（Actin 为上样参照）。怎么读：这是 2010 年的经典示例，正面标志物齐全；但按 MISEV2023 的标准，还应补充阴性/污染标志物（如唾液中的淀粉酶、黏蛋白等高丰度蛋白）以及颗粒定量，本图未包含这些内容。
figures.original_shows_en: Saliva exosomes (120,000 × g pellet): (A) EM with uranyl acetate showing ~60 nm vesicles; (B) immunogold anti-CD63; (C) FACS of CD63 on bead-bound exosomes; (D) WB of CD63 and Alix, lane 1 whole saliva protein, lane 2 exosome pellet.
figures.original_legend_quote: EM image of human saliva showing round-shaped exosomes. The 120,000×g pellets from saliva were used for exosomes analysis. (A) Electron micrographs of saliva exosomes were fixed in 2% formaldehyde and contrasted using 2% uranyl acetate. The image shows small vesicles of ∼60 nm in diameter. (B) Exosomes were labeled with immunogold anti-CD63. Note the immunoreactivity of CD63 on the surface of the single exosome. (C) Representative FACS analysis of exosomes showing expression of CD63. Open trace shows the saliva exosomes, filled trace shows saliva exosomes incubated with latex beads and stained with anti-CD63 followed by secondary Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated antibody. (D) Western blot analysis of saliva exosomes using an antibody against CD63 and Alix. Lane 1 is the protein extract of normal saliva, and lane 2 contains protein from the exosome pellet obtained from ultracentrifugation.
figures.sample_type: 人唾液，12 万 g 超速离心沉淀
figures.instrument_method: TEM（醋酸铀负染）、CD63 免疫金电镜、流式（CD63）、Western blot（CD63、Alix）
